The '''Twin DF.9''' was an anti-[[Infantry/Legends|infantry]] weapon produced by [[Golan Arms/Legends|Golan Arms]] was comprised of twin rapid-fire [[DF.9 laser cannon]]s attached to a larger [[Power generator/Legends|power generator]]. The unit was fitted with advanced [[Laser actuator/Legends|laser actuators]] that gave the Twin DF.9 a fire rate of one energy bolt per second,<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> but produced a smaller blast radius smaller than a standard DF.9. Many Twin DF.9s were self-propelled, and these were designated as the [[Twin SP.9]]. The Twin DF.9 also featured heavier armor on the housing, giving it greater protection to incoming [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] fire. Officially, the Twin DF.9 was only available for purchase by the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]], or other [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]-allied military forces.<ref name="RASB2" />
